steps.name: verified-preflight-and-arm
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ca1952cd6b06a8ba999bd54f4ad41606e63e4727"
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'
adb start-server >/dev/null
adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'
echo '--- vault ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell run-as "$PKG" ls -l no_backup/identity-vault-v1.bin
echo 'identity_vault_present=true'
echo '--- grants ---'
OUT="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys package "$PKG")"
for P in android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS; do
  echo "$OUT" | grep -E "$P: granted=true" | head -1
done
echo 'runtime_permissions_ready=true'
echo '--- local model ---'
MODEL='/sdcard/Android/data/pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/files/models/gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm'
if adb -s "$SEL" shell ls -l "$MODEL" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'gemma4_model_present=true'
else
  echo 'gemma4_model_present=false'
fi
adb -s "$SEL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f shared_prefs/debug_auto_clir_bootstrap.xml shared_prefs/campaign_runtime_status_v1.xml
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.calls.live_call_readiness --serial "$SEL"

steps.name: launch-and-observe-real-call
